easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mana Vault, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
